config.prompt: Collaborate on the same screen in target mockups, node ${{shared-request.payload.node_id}}. Brief: ${{shared-request.payload.brief}}. Your assignment: ${{shared-request.payload.assignment_a}}. Other authors may edit this screen concurrently. Preserve their changes. Use figma_query inspect before each small figma_execute edit, include expected_revision, and use stable unique request IDs. On a stale revision, inspect and revise your edit. If an operation is uncertain, stop and report its operation_id; do not retry with a new ID. Stay within your granted design area.
